errors.text: The proposed BCC/B2 lamellar constitution is not supported for the Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr compositional system; the cited B2 evidence concerns an AlCoCrFeNi eutectic with fundamentally different chemistry and phase stability.
The hypothesis omits the target intervention—4.2 at.% Cr addition by vacuum arc melting—and therefore misses the observed reticulated Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.

The proposed mechanism does not capture the experimentally relevant combination of Cr-induced lattice contraction/solid-solution hardening and crack hindrance by a low-volume-fraction interconnected Laves network.
Tensile elongation predictions are not directly comparable with the target compression fracture strain, so the claimed ductility improvement lacks a valid common baseline.

The predicted density below 8.0 g/cm3 is not supported by a specified composition, calculated rule-of-mixtures density, or experimental evidence; retaining substantial Hf, Mo, and Ta makes this target especially uncertain.
